description: Coming back? Pass the `continuity_handle` from any earlier GAIP result and get what changed since your last visit: new events on your watches, verdict changes on targets you checked before and receipts added under your handle. Reads only your own records. Free, read-only, no account. Inputs must be public and non-personal; calling declares that (data_classification defaults to PUBLIC).

since.description: Optional RFC 3339 time; default is your previous digest visit (else 7 days).

name: gaip_since_last_call
title: What changed since my last call
